[13:49] **Ray:** @allHello guys,

Good afternoon!

Tomorrow we’re playing again, and the team that wins the most sets takes the ₦20,000 prize.

Ahead of tomorrow and furthermore  it’s only right that we address a few things.

Match Rules

*Kick off 5pm.

*Kindly respect and obey the referee’s decisions.

*Red card: 2-minute out or a 3-throwing out call.

*Match duration: Each match lasts 8 minutes. Once the 8 minutes have elapsed, play continues until the ball has gone out of play twice. However, this additional period must not exceed 2 minutes. If the ball has not gone out of play twice within those 2 minutes, the referee will blow the final whistle and end the match.

*Intentional handball inside the box: Penalty.

*Unintentional handball: Free kick or play on, depending on the referee’s decision.

*Arriving late: Please do not join the game immediately. Wait for the referee to invite you onto the pitch instead of walking in during play.

*Every player has the right to question a decision, but please do so respectfully and without aggression. The referee is in charge. They cannot see everything, and not every decision will be perfect. Put yourself in the referee’s shoes if you were the one officiating.

PLAYERS

*Please avoid entering the pitch if it’s not your turn to play. The referee will notify the next set at the end of each match.

*If you foul an opponent, saying “sorry” doesn’t hurt anyone’s ego. Apologize, then continue the game.

PAYING FOR SOMEONE

If you paid for someone else’s slot, you are only entitled to play in their place if they are unavailable to play that day.

However, once that player has already played and then leaves, their teammates will decide who replaces them for the remaining games—not the person who paid for them. ( No na my guy or brother ) The payment only guarantees their participation, not replacement rights after they’ve already played already .

RESPECT FOR ONE ANOTHER

Every player has the right to question a decision they genuinely believe is unfair, but please do so respectfully—not violently or abusively.

Let’s respect one another inclusive of our team mates and not just opponents and keep the atmosphere friendly. Please! 🙏

It’s all love, guys. We’re here to have fun, enjoy the game, meet new people, and network if possible.

Business ideas are also welcome.

> _Ray: @allHello guys,

Good afternoon!

Tomorrow we’re playing again, and the team that wins the most sets takes the ₦20,000 prize.

Ahead of tomorrow and furthermore  it’s only right that we address a few things.

Match Rules

*Kick off 5pm.

*Kindly respect and obey the referee’s decisions.

*Red card: 2-minute out or a 3-throwing out call.

*Match duration: Each match lasts 8 minutes. Once the 8 minutes have elapsed, play continues until the ball has gone out of play twice. However, this additional period must not exceed 2 minutes. If the ball has not gone out of play twice within those 2 minutes, the referee will blow the final whistle and end the match.

*Intentional handball inside the box: Penalty.

*Unintentional handball: Free kick or play on, depending on the referee’s decision.

*Arriving late: Please do not join the game immediately. Wait for the referee to invite you onto the pitch instead of walking in during play.

*Every player has the right to question a decision, but please do so respectfully and without aggression. The referee is in charge. They cannot see everything, and not every decision will be perfect. Put yourself in the referee’s shoes if you were the one officiating.

PLAYERS

*Please avoid entering the pitch if it’s not your turn to play. The referee will notify the next set at the end of each match.

*If you foul an opponent, saying “sorry” doesn’t hurt anyone’s ego. Apologize, then continue the game.

PAYING FOR SOMEONE

If you paid for someone else’s slot, you are only entitled to play in their place if they are unavailable to play that day.

However, once that player has already played and then leaves, their teammates will decide who replaces them for the remaining games—not the person who paid for them. ( No na my guy or brother ) The payment only guarantees their participation, not replacement rights after they’ve already played already .

RESPECT FOR ONE ANOTHER

Every player has the right to question a decision they genuinely believe is unfair, but please do so respectfully—not violently or abusively.

Let’s respect one another inclusive of our team mates and not just opponents and keep the atmosphere friendly. Please! 🙏

It’s all love, guys. We’re here to have fun, enjoy the game, meet new people, and network if possible.

Business ideas are also welcome.

Finally, if anyone has any suggestions or concerns, please feel free to share them. We can address them together right away.

Thank you, and let’s have a great game tomorrow! 
⚽❤️🌚_

[16:08] **Ray:**
> _Ray: @allHello guys,

Good afternoon!

Tomorrow we’re playing again, and the team that wins the most sets takes the ₦20,000 prize.

Ahead of tomorrow and furthermore  it’s only right that we address a few things.

Match Rules

*Kick off 5pm.

*Kindly respect and obey the referee’s decisions.

*Red card: 2-minute out or a 3-throwing out call.

*Match duration: Each match lasts 8 minutes. Once the 8 minutes have elapsed, play continues until the ball has gone out of play twice. However, this additional period must not exceed 2 minutes. If the ball has not gone out of play twice within those 2 minutes, the referee will blow the final whistle and end the match.

*Intentional handball inside the box: Penalty.

*Unintentional handball: Free kick or play on, depending on the referee’s decision.

*Arriving late: Please do not join the game immediately. Wait for the referee to invite you onto the pitch instead of walking in during play.

*Every player has the right to question a decision, but please do so respectfully and without aggression. The referee is in charge. They cannot see everything, and not every decision will be perfect. Put yourself in the referee’s shoes if you were the one officiating.

PLAYERS

*Please avoid entering the pitch if it’s not your turn to play. The referee will notify the next set at the end of each match.

*If you foul an opponent, saying “sorry” doesn’t hurt anyone’s ego. Apologize, then continue the game.

PAYING FOR SOMEONE

If you paid for someone else’s slot, you are only entitled to play in their place if they are unavailable to play that day.

However, once that player has already played and then leaves, their teammates will decide who replaces them for the remaining games—not the person who paid for them. ( No na my guy or brother ) The payment only guarantees their participation, not replacement rights after they’ve already played already .

RESPECT FOR ONE ANOTHER

Every player has the right to question a decision they genuinely believe is unfair, but please do so respectfully—not violently or abusively.

Let’s respect one another inclusive of our team mates and not just opponents and keep the atmosphere friendly. Please! 🙏

It’s all love, guys. We’re here to have fun, enjoy the game, meet new people, and network if possible.

Business ideas are also welcome.

Finally, if anyone has any suggestions or concerns, please feel free to share them. We can address them together right away.

Thank you, and let’s have a great game tomorrow! 
⚽❤️🌚_

Good afternoon!

Match Rules

*Kick off 5pm.

*Kindly respect and obey the referee’s decisions.

*Red card: 2-minute out or a 3-throwing out call.

*Match duration: Each match lasts 8 minutes. Once the 8 minutes have elapsed, play continues until the ball has gone out of play twice. However, this additional period must not exceed 2 minutes. If the ball has not gone out of play twice within those 2 minutes, the referee will blow the final whistle and end the match.

*Intentional handball inside the box: Penalty.

*Unintentional handball: Free kick or play on, depending on the referee’s decision.

*Arriving late: Please do not join the game immediately. Wait for the referee to invite you onto the pitch instead of walking in during play.

*Every player has the right to question a decision, but please do so respectfully and without aggression. The referee is in charge. They cannot see everything, and not every decision will be perfect. Put yourself in the referee’s shoes if you were the one officiating.

PLAYERS

*Please avoid entering the pitch if it’s not your turn to play. The referee will notify the next set at the end of each match.

*If you foul an opponent, saying “sorry” doesn’t hurt anyone’s ego. Apologize, then continue the game.

PAYING FOR SOMEONE

If you paid for someone else’s slot, you are only entitled to play in their place if they are unavailable to play that day.

However, once that player has already played and then leaves, their teammates will decide who replaces them for the remaining games—not the person who paid for them. ( No na my guy or brother ) The payment only guarantees their participation, not replacement rights after they’ve already played already .

RESPECT FOR ONE ANOTHER

Every player has the right to question a decision they genuinely believe is unfair, but please do so respectfully—not violently or abusively.

Let’s respect one another inclusive of our team mates and not just opponents and keep the atmosphere friendly. Please! 🙏

It’s all love, guys. We’re here to have fun, enjoy the game, meet new people, and network if possible.

Business ideas are also welcome.

Finally, if anyone has any suggestions or concerns, please feel free to share them. We can address them together right away.

Thank you, and let’s have a great game tomorrow! 
⚽❤️🌚

🏆 BALL GROUP INDOOR FOOTBALL TOURNAMENT
📅 Date: Friday, 6th November 2026
Time (4:30pm -8pm )
Guys, we’ve got something exciting cooking for next Friday! 💯

We’ll be hosting a competitive indoor 5-a-side football tournament exclusively for members of this group.

IMPORTANT: This tournament is strictly for group members only. No outsiders or third-party players will be allowed to participate.

🏆 1. TEAM CAPTAINS & REGISTRATION

We need 8 volunteer captains to lead their respective teams.

* Each captain is required to contribute ₦20,000.
* The 8 captains will be randomly assigned positions from Captain 1 to Captain 8.
* Each captain will choose a unique team name.
* Every captain will also play for their respective team.

⚽ 2. PLAYER SELECTION & TEAM FORMATION

After assigning the captains, we’ll proceed with the player selection process which includes your goalkeeper in your 5 man team. 

* Captains will take turns picking players from the group, starting from Captain 1 through Captain 8.
* The selection order will then reverse from Captain 8 back to Captain 1.
* This back-and-forth selection process will continue until every captain has selected 4 players, making a total of 5 players per team, including the captain.

At the end of the selection process, we’ll have 8 teams competing for the ultimate prize! 🔥

🥅 3. TOURNAMENT FORMAT

The tournament will follow a knockout format, starting with the quarter-finals.

Quarter-finals: The 8 teams will compete in 4 fixtures. The 4 winning teams will advance to the semi-finals.

Semi-finals: The 4 remaining teams will compete in 2 fixtures. The 2 winning teams will advance to the final.

Final: The 2 remaining teams will battle it out for the championship!

The quarter-final matchups will be randomly drawn after all teams have been formed.

Examples:

* Captain 5’s team vs Captain 1’s team
* Captain 6’s team vs Captain 3’s team

And so on, until all 4 quarter-final fixtures have been determined.

⏱️ 4. MATCH DURATION & TIE-BREAKER

Each match will consist of:

* First half: 10 minutes
* Half-time break: 3–5 minutes
* Second half: 10 minutes

Total playing time: 20 minutes per match, excluding the half-time break.

🥅 WHAT HAPPENS IF A MATCH ENDS IN A DRAW?

If a match is tied at full-time, the result will be decided by a penalty shootout.

* Each team will take 3 penalty kicks initially.
* If the scores remain level after the first 3 kicks per team, the shootout will proceed to sudden death.
* During sudden death, both teams will take one kick each per round until one team scores and the other misses in the same round.
* The team that scores while its opponent misses will win the match and advance to the next round.

There will be no extra time.

📋 5. ADDITIONAL MATCH RULES

To ensure fair play and consistency, the following rules will apply throughout the tournament:

1. Throw-ins

* Throw-ins must be taken from behind the touchline.
* Players must not step over the line when taking a throw-in.

2. Intentional Handball

* Any intentional handball by a defending player inside their own penalty area will result in a penalty kick for the opposing team.

3. Goalkeeper Back-Pass Rule

* The goalkeeper must not handle the ball with their hands when a teammate deliberately passes it back to them with their feet.
* Any violation will be penalized accordingly.

🟥 6. DISCIPLINARY RULES & FINES

To ensure discipline, fair play, and respect throughout the tournament, the following fines will apply:

🟨 Yellow Card: ₦1,000

🟥 Red Card: ₦2,000 (2 MINUTES OUT)

🗣️ Yelling at or disrespecting the referee: ₦1,000

⚠️ IMPORTANT NOTICE:

All fines must be paid during the half-time break OR at the end of the match if it’s after the halftime.

Failure to pay the required fine within the half-time or full time interval may result in the offending team facing possible disqualification from the tournament.

All captains are responsible for communicating these rules to their players and ensuring that everyone maintains proper discipline on the pitch. This is the Main purpose of he fine.

Please advise your players to respect the referee, follow the rules, and conduct themselves properly throughout the competition.

Play with passion, compete with respect, and let discipline speak! ⚽🤝

💰 7. PRIZE MONEY

Here’s what the teams and players will be competing for:

🥇 1st Position — ₦60,000

🥈 2nd Position — ₦40,000

🏅 Most Valuable Player (MVP) — ₦10,000

🗳️ 8. MVP SELECTION

The MVP will be determined by voting on the pitch.

Players from the other teams will vote for the player they believe performed best throughout the tournament.

Voting must be fair and unbiased. Participants should vote based on performance and not on friendship or personal relationships.

* During sudden death, both teams will take one kick each per round until one team scores and the other misses in the same round.
* The team that scores while its opponent misses will win the match and advance to the next round.

There will be no extra time.

📋 5. ADDITIONAL MATCH RULES

To ensure fair play and consistency, the following rules will apply throughout the tournament:

1. Throw-ins

* Throw-ins must be taken from behind the touchline.
* Players must not step over the line when taking a throw-in.

2. Intentional Handball

* Any intentional handball by a defending player inside their own penalty area will result in a penalty kick for the opposing team.

3. Goalkeeper Back-Pass Rule

* The goalkeeper must not handle the ball with their hands when a teammate deliberately passes it back to them with their feet.
* Any violation will be penalized accordingly.

🟥 6. DISCIPLINARY RULES & FINES

To ensure discipline, fair play, and respect throughout the tournament, the following fines will apply:

🟨 Yellow Card: ₦1,000

🟥 Red Card: ₦2,000 (2 MINUTES OUT)

🗣️ Yelling at or disrespecting the referee: ₦1,000

⚠️ IMPORTANT NOTICE:

All fines must be paid during the half-time break OR at the end of the match if it’s after the halftime.

Failure to pay the required fine within the half-time or full time interval may result in the offending team facing possible disqualification from the tournament.

All captains are responsible for communicating these rules to their players and ensuring that everyone maintains proper discipline on the pitch. This is the Main purpose of he fine.

Please advise your players to respect the referee, follow the rules, and conduct themselves properly throughout the competition.

Play with passion, compete with respect, and let discipline speak! ⚽🤝

💰 7. PRIZE MONEY

Here’s what the teams and players will be competing for:

🥇 1st Position — ₦60,000

🥈 2nd Position — ₦40,000

🏅 Most Valuable Player (MVP) — ₦10,000

🗳️ 8. MVP SELECTION

The MVP will be determined by voting on the pitch.

Players from the other teams will vote for the player they believe performed best throughout the tournament.

Voting must be fair and unbiased. Participants should vote based on performance and not on friendship or personal relationships.

The player with the highest number of votes will be crowned Tournament MVP and receive the ₦10,000 prize.

📢 9. FINAL NOTE

Guys, this is an opportunity for us to have fun, compete, showcase our skills, and strengthen the bond within our group.

We want a competitive but friendly atmosphere, with fair play, discipline, and respect for everyone.

We need 8 serious volunteer captains to step forward! If you’re interested in captaining a team, indicate your interest in the group.

Start getting ready, because this one is going to be competitive! 🔥🔥

🏆 8 TEAMS. 1 CHAMPION. LET THE BEST TEAM WIN! ⚽💯_

Each of the 8captains will be responsible for selecting 4 players that’s includes your goal keeper , making a total of 5 players per team, including the captain. 

HOW THE SELECTION WILL WORK

There will be 4 rounds of selection, with each captain picking one player per round.

ROUND 1 – FROM POT 1
Picking order: Captain 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5 → 6 → 7 → 8.

ROUND 2 – FROM POT 2

[11:38] **Ray:** @all  TOURNAMENT FORMAT & OFFICIAL RULES

1. MATCH DURATION
* Quarter-finals: 10 minutes per half (20 minutes total).
* Semi-finals: 8 minutes per half (16 minutes total).
* Final: 8 minutes per half (16 minutes total).
* Half-time break: 2 minutes between.
Strict timing applies. No additional time for balls going out of play. Once time expires and the 2 min left is said, the referee blows the final whistle.

1. DRAWS & PENALTIES
If the match ends in a draw at full time whistle. We proceed to penalty shootout to determine the winner.

* Two penalty kicks per team initially.
* If still level, sudden death follows until a winner emerges.
* ⁠When taking a penalty, the other foot must remain close to the ball before kicking the ball. Any encroachment or violation observed by the referee may result in a retake.

1. GOALKEEPER RULES
* No handling of a pass from your teammate; clear with the feet if needed. Violation results in a corner kick to the opponents.
* Goalkeepers have 8 seconds to release the ball during a goal kick.
* A goalkeeper fouling an opponent inside the 18-yard box results in an indirect free kick.

1. CORNER KICKS
* Defending players must remain inside the 18-yard box or centre circle until the corner is taken.

1. FOULS & PENALTIES
* Intentional handball inside the 18-yard box results in a penalty.
* Dangerous tackles and deliberate attempts to injure opponents will not be tolerated.

1. CARDS & FINES
* Yellow card: ₦500.
* Red card: ₦1,000.
* Two yellow cards result in a red card.
* A red-carded player serves a 2-minute suspension and may return only with the referee’s permission, as provided by our tournament rules.

1. MISCONDUCT
Abusive language, insults, unnecessary provocation and violent behaviour will attract disciplinary action, including a possible red card.

FINE PAYMENT:
* First-half cards: Pay at half-time.
* Second-half cards: If your team qualifies, payment must be made immediately.

 TEAM ELIGIBILITY
* Teams must use only their officially selected players.
* Borrowing players from another team to make up numbers is strictly prohibited.
* Using a player from another team as a goalkeeper at any point is also prohibited.

1. CAPTAINS’ RESPONSIBILITIES
Captains handle all communication or complaints to the referee, ensure fines are paid and maintain discipline within their teams.

Failure to settle fines may result in team elimination and the opposing team advancing.

1. PLAYER OF THE TOURNAMENT
The award will be decided strictly by votes from the team captains.

1. FAIR PLAY
Respect the referee, opponents and teammates. Avoid dangerous challenges and unnecessary injuries.
NO ONE IS ABOVE THE RULES.

🏆 PLAY FAIR. RESPECT THE GAME. RESPECT EACH OTHER.
GOOD LUCK TO ALL TEAMS! ⚽

[12:02] **nun:** @all  TOURNAMENT FORMAT & OFFICIAL RULES

1. MATCH DURATION
* Quarter-finals: 10 minutes per half (20 minutes total).
* Semi-finals: 8 minutes per half (16 minutes total).
* Final: 8 minutes per half (16 minutes total).
* Half-time break: 2 minutes between.
Strict timing applies. No additional time for balls going out of play. Once time expires and the 2 min left is said, the referee blows the final whistle.

1. DRAWS & PENALTIES
If the match ends in a draw at full time whistle. We proceed to penalty shootout to determine the winner.

* Two penalty kicks per team initially.
* If still level, sudden death follows until a winner emerges.
* ⁠When taking a penalty, the other foot must remain close to the ball before kicking the ball. Any encroachment or violation observed by the referee may result in a retake.

1. GOALKEEPER RULES
* No handling of a pass from your teammate; clear with the feet if needed. Violation results in a corner kick to the opponents.
* Goalkeepers have 8 seconds to release the ball during a goal kick.
* A goalkeeper fouling an opponent inside the 18-yard box results in an indirect free kick.

1. CORNER KICKS
* Defending players must remain inside the 18-yard box or centre circle until the corner is taken.

1. FOULS & PENALTIES
* Intentional handball inside the 18-yard box results in a penalty.
* Dangerous tackles and deliberate attempts to injure opponents will not be tolerated.

1. CARDS & FINES
* Yellow card: ₦500.
* Red card: ₦1,000.
* Two yellow cards result in a red card.
* A red-carded player serves a 2-minute suspension and may return only with the referee’s permission, as provided by our tournament rules.

1. MISCONDUCT
Abusive language, insults, unnecessary provocation and violent behaviour will attract disciplinary action, including a possible red card.

FINE PAYMENT:
* First-half cards: Pay at half-time.
* Second-half cards: If your team qualifies, payment must be made immediately.

 TEAM ELIGIBILITY
* Teams must use only their officially selected players.
* Borrowing players from another team to make up numbers is strictly prohibited.
* Using a player from another team as a goalkeeper at any point is also prohibited.

1. CAPTAINS’ RESPONSIBILITIES
Captains handle all communication or complaints to the referee, ensure fines are paid and maintain discipline within their teams.

Failure to settle fines may result in team elimination and the opposing team advancing.

1. PLAYER OF THE TOURNAMENT
The award will be decided strictly by votes from the team captains.

1. FAIR PLAY
Respect the referee, opponents and teammates. Avoid dangerous challenges and unnecessary injuries.
NO ONE IS ABOVE THE RULES.

🏆 PLAY FAIR. RESPECT THE GAME. RESPECT EACH OTHER.
GOOD LUCK TO ALL TEAMS! ⚽
